\subsubsection{Current terminal distribution and latent-state diagnostics}

The unified bands above use the current 27 August 2026 Team~8 calibration,
8,192 paths and the independent Barrick realised-price anchor required by the
corporate experiment. The evidence below answers a narrower question: how the
same four parameter objects behave when simulated directly at the GLD level.
Its 4,096 paths, 260 steps, GLD starting level of 422.57 and current NSS
forward-rate curve must not be mixed numerically with the corporate valuation
run.
